method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (sda-home.l4, sda-vehicles.l4, taa-procedure.l4, with shared nouns in sda-common.l4) holding 12 regulative rules, and a seat layer (sda-seat.l4, 39 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a conveyance or registration before 1 July 2017, or a home concession question before 4 May 2010 (s 102, gated in the core), or interest running into a financial year with no market rate given, answers `not covered`, asserted); corrected on 24 Oct 2026 after an independent verification (NOTES.md findings 21-25); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Stamp Duty Act 1978 (NT), reprint REPS013, as in force at 1 July 2025, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Stamp-Duty-Act-1978-NT-current-reprint-REPS013.txt; brought in: Taxation Administration Act 2007 (NT), reprint REPT039, as in force at 1 July 2024, deposited at ../../../taxation-administration-act-2007/registers/source-bundle/Taxation-Administration-Act-2007-NT-current-reprint-REPT039.txt. The deposited Schedule 1 is applied from 1 July 2017 (commencement of No. 13, 2017, s 11, its last recorded amendment). Schedule 1 cl 1(2)(a) 'V2' read as V squared (finding 1); the deposit is not altered. No regulation is deposited: threshold amount $650 000 (s 88(1)), the market interest rate (TAA s 35(2)) an input, one for each financial year.

checks.result: 299 assertions satisfied (136 home, 33 vehicles, 60 TAA, 70 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the corrections); 13 #TRACEs with an expect line (8 breaches, 5 obligations pending), each read and as expected; two control copies with expected values altered failed as they should

scope: From the seat of the individual buyer and taxpayer. Stamp Duty Act: ss 4, 4A(1) (input), 4AB, 4AC; ss 5, 6, Schedule 1 cl 1(2), (3) (conveyance scale, joint tenants +$5); s 50(a), s 9(7) (who is liable); s 9(1), (3), (3A), (5), (6) (lodge within 60 days, pay by the last lodgement day; regulative); Part 5 Division 2: s 88 amounts, threshold, period for occupancy and prescribed period; s 88A (Division ends with conveyances first executed on 30 June 2021); ss 89, 89AA, 89AAB, 89AAC, 89A, 90, 90AA conditions and date windows; ss 90A, 90AB (grant reassessments; regulative); s 90B; the 30-day notices of failure to occupy (ss 89(3), 89AA(6), 89AAB(7), 89A(3), 90(3), 90D(5)) with the Commissioner's must-reassess (regulative); s 102; Division 2A ss 90C, 90D (new home from a building contractor, 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2027); s 91 with s 91(3) refund (regulative); Schedule 2 items 6(d), 6(e), 7; vehicles: s 57(1) with s 58(1) (regulative), s 59(1), (1A), (2), (3), (5) (regulative), s 59A (regulative), s 61, Schedule 1 cl 5, s 92A, Schedule 2 item 23(a), (b), (e), (j)(i), (j)(v), (k). Taxation Administration Act: ss 21(4), 27, 34-36 (worked one financial year at a time, the market rate for each year an input), 39, 41-43 (s 43 regulative; the s 41(3) bar on reduction for concealment or suppression only), 107, 109-111, 113-117 (objection, review and appeal for duty and first home owner grant decisions; regulative), 128 (regulative). Out: corporate reconstruction, partnerships, landholder duty (Div 8A), trusts, options, insurance duty, family farms, managed investment schemes, leases, partitions, savings rules for replacement contracts, guardians, Housing Act schemes, other item 23 exemptions, TAA machinery. The NT levies no land tax, so there is no land tax or principal place of residence exemption to encode; rates concessions are not in statute here. Read with ../../../first-home-owner-grant-act-2000/encodings/baseline-2026-10/ (grant entitlement is an input here) and the Commonwealth Social Security, Veterans' Entitlements, GST and Family Law Act encodings; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the individual buyer and taxpayer: the conveyee of a home in the Territory, or the applicant registering a motor vehicle
